description: This file defines an interface for a grain in Orleans, specifically for a stateless worker grain, providing asynchronous methods for long-running calls, retrieving call statistics, and a dummy call.

classes.name: IStatelessWorkerGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain interface for a stateless worker, extending IGrainWithIntegerKey, defining asynchronous methods for communication with the grain.

methods.name: LongCall
methods.description: An asynchronous method representing a long-running call operation.

methods.name: GetCallStats
methods.description: An asynchronous method returning call statistics encapsulated in a Tuple.

methods.name: DummyCall
methods.description: An asynchronous method serving as a dummy operation.
